meaning: A machine with a bright lamp that shines a see-through sheet onto a wall or screen, so the writing looks big.
clues: It uses light to make something big enough for a whole room to see.
The sheet it shows is clear plastic, and a teacher could write on it with a marker while everyone watched.
It sat on a table. The light came up from a flat glass top and bounced off a mirror above.
The clear sheets were called transparencies.
It has two words. The first starts with O and means above your head.
assumes: A slide projector shows photo slides
A chalkboard is written on with chalk
A whiteboard is written on with markers

decoys.meaning: A machine that shines light through small photo slides to show them on a screen.
A dark board that you write on with chalk.
A smooth white board that you write on with special markers.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: I loved those! A teacher could slide on a sheet and write on it while the class watched. We called them transparencies.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Today's version: slides on a laptop, shown on a big screen or TV. Tip: save your slides in two places before a talk.
